['Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA '].company_description: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA is a European multinational health care company based in Bad Homburg vor der Höhe, Germany. It provides products and services for dialysis in hospitals, as well as inpatient and outpatient medical care. The company is involved in hospital management and in engineering and services for medical centers and other health care facilities. Additionally, Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA, a subsidiary of Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA, specializes in providing kidney dialysis services through a network of outpatient dialysis centers worldwide.

['Traton SE '].company_description: Traton SE, formerly known as Volkswagen Truck & Bus AG, is a subsidiary of the Volkswagen Group and one of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers. It operates through its brands MAN, Scania, Navistar, and Volkswagen Caminhões e Ônibus. Traton offers a range of products including light-, medium-, and heavy-duty trucks, vans, and buses. As of 2020, Traton employed around 82,600 people in its commercial vehicle brands.
